section.title: Ordering Steps by Data, Not by Time
section.why: Splitting a module by when steps happen instead of by what actually varies independently makes every step's interface leak into the next one.
section.question: This onboarding flow is split into CollectProfileStep, VerifyEmailStep, and SendWelcomeStep classes that pass a mutable session hash between them in a fixed order. What's a better way to decompose it?
section.teaching_note: Ask what each step actually needs to know, rather than what order it currently runs in.
